chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from one of his companions, from Harun ibn Kharjat, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When it is the middle of Sha'ban, a caller calls out from the highest horizon: 'O visitors of the grave of Al-Husayn! Return, forgiven for you, and your reward is with your Lord, and Muhammad is your Prophet.'

key_terms.النِّصْفُ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ: The middle of the month of Sha'ban (15th)
key_terms.زَائِرِي قَبْرِ الْحُسَيْنِ: Visitors of the grave of Al-Husayn

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the fifteenth of Sha'ban for visitors to the grave of Imam Al-Husayn?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the spiritual significance of Laylat al-Bara'ah (the Night of Forgiveness) by linking it directly to the veneration of Imam Al-Husayn (AS). The 'caller from the highest horizon' (al-ufuq al-a'la) signifies a celestial announcement, emphasizing that visiting his grave is a means of securing divine forgiveness and reward, thereby elevating the practice of Ziyarat to a cosmic act of worship.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from one of his companions, from Haroun Bin Kharjat, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whenever it is the middle of Shabaan, a Caller Calls our from the high horizons: ‘Indeed! Visitors of the grave of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>! Return (to your homes) as (your sins have been) Forgiven for you, and your Rewards are upon your Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, and Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>, your Prophet<sup>saww</sup>!’
en.sarwar: 9. Afi ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from certain individuals of his from Harun ibn Kharijah who has said the following: “

In the middle of the month of Sha‘ban an announcer announces from the high horizon, ‘O visitors of al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, you may return home. Your sins are forgiven and your reward is with your Lord and Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, Your prophet.’”
